description: Adopt-A-Highway (AAH) All Highways is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. The AAHallHighway feature class displays Adopt-A-Highway sites as highway segments for the entire California State Highway Network, merged from all 12 Caltrans districts into one statewide layer. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are AAH, Caltrans, GIS, LRS, SHN, adopt-a-highway, adoptable sites, highway segments. The bounding box given is -124.2649,32.5443,-114.3003,42.0055. The hub shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is None. This dataset is approved for public distribution. Personally identifiable applicant contact information from the source Adopt-A-Highway database is removed during processing.. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
